stories.title: Bind every MCP operation to a live launch

user_story.want: each launch to receive fresh, bounded communication authority
user_story.benefit: an old or cancelled agent cannot continue reading or submitting work
notes: Source: feature-spec Attempt authority, Data Model, Business Rules and Edge Cases.

acceptance_criteria.text: After the #263/#264 prerequisites land, cold, resume, failed-resume fallback and cold fallback each receive a distinct capability bound to the adopted factory launch identity, broker instance, immutable repository/task/mode/frozen scope and bounded attempt expiry; no competing attempt identity or new universal 30-minute run limit is introduced.

Every MCP discovery, preflight, submit, receipt/status and exact duplicate/replay request refuses replaced, expired, cancelled, closed, wrong-broker or otherwise foreign launch authority before accessing the shared service, including historical reads. Refuse at now >= attempt expiry using fresh bookkeeping time, not turn-start time.

Caller-supplied selectors cannot replace or widen the factory repository, task, mode, permission digest, frozen revisions or authorized targets; cross-attempt and wrong-scope requests are denied without backend effects.

Authority is rechecked transactionally at mutation admission. Revocation before admission prevents the operation; after durable admission it denies subsequent calls and cancels outstanding contexts while preserving already-recorded work for reconciliation. Revocation does not wait for a slow external effect.

A broker/daemon restart generates a fresh instance identity and never restores old descriptors or grants as live authority. Independently authorized factory recovery retains historical result/replay semantics; stricter MCP guards do not globally revoke legitimate internal historical reads.

Real temporary SQLite and private-socket tests cover each operation against active/replaced/expired/cancelled/closed/restarted authority, launch replacement and selector isolation, with synchronized admission/revocation races and exact expiry boundaries.

stories.title: Add scoped communication tools without limiting existing agent tools

user_story.want: this server’s communication tools to respect mode and scope while my agent keeps its existing permitted tools
user_story.benefit: agents gain reliable result communication without losing their normal coding options
notes: Source: feature-spec Scoped service dispatch, Permissions, Business Rules and Compatibility.
Run 0005 owner clarification for #276: MCP is additive; its own allowlist is not a global agent-tool allowlist. Retired AC-004 is replaced by AC-007; AC-008 is a new additive-policy obligation.

acceptance_criteria.text: An immutable registered-tool catalog is the single allowlist for tools/list and tools/call. Unknown tools, missing mode/effect classifications and unassigned permissions deny by default; only executable registered handlers appear, with no placeholder future family tools.

Initial communication_preflight, communication_submit and communication_receipt handlers delegate exactly once to the adopted shared JSON services and lifecycle bridge. Preserve input bytes, validation diagnostics, durable application request correlation and separate input/engineering/acceptance/remote-effect receipt states; do not introduce a second validator or independently submit the same content to old and new services.

Research and Spike may communicate their own applicable results; Plan its discussion/completed input under existing lifecycle timing; Implement its authorized frozen-scope results/checkpoints; Validate its retained assessment/result and permitted receipts only. Direct calls outside these operation/selector profiles fail even if a client retained an earlier tool list.

Within this MCP server, Validate refuses fresh execution capture, shell/test execution, creation, waiver, acceptance override, dispatch, mode change and broader scope. Retained assessment communication succeeds without self-acceptance. This server exposes no shell, execution, waiver, dispatch, arbitrary forge, mode-change or acceptance-override tool in any mode. These catalog restrictions do not remove native tools or unrelated MCP servers already permitted by existing host/mode policy; existing Validate no-shell/retained-evidence and project-MCP restrictions remain intact.

Creation effect classification follows actual effects, including aliases and deferred publication initiated through communication submission. MCP-origin input cannot create issues later by dropping its policy constraint: persist a factory-stamped origin/effect restriction through recovery, retaining truthful pending input or refusing an unsafe route. Existing terminal/helper Plan publication policy remains unchanged.

Tests exercise discovery and direct invocation for every mode, selector denial, Validate retained versus fresh evidence, backend call counts and initial shared-service compatibility. A deterministic deferred-publication test proves MCP input cannot bypass creation restrictions after acceptance or recovery.

Keep this server’s ToolProfile distinct from the agent’s existing Permissions and host tool inventory. Constructing or omitting its neutral registration preserves existing permission fields and currently allowed unrelated configuration, with immutable before/after request snapshots and source-boundary assertions proving no global MCP-only tool policy is introduced. Actual native host inventory preservation and registration merge are independently implemented and verified in #274; offline producer fixtures cannot claim that host proof.

stories.title: Expose a bounded stdio MCP adapter with configurable automatic startup

user_story.want: a standard local tool endpoint with configurable automatic availability for each active agent attempt
user_story.benefit: hosts can connect without requiring manual server startup for every session or handling factory credentials
notes: Source: feature-spec Stdio adapter, API / Interface Changes and Business Rules.

Run 0005 owner request for #277: add automatic startup configuration. #272 delivers its setting and neutral registration producer; #274 delivers actual host consumption, startup/teardown and connection evidence. Default true is an explicit planning assumption.

acceptance_criteria.text: litefactory mcp serve --descriptor <path> starts a credential-free stdio adapter using the existing private submission client/broker. It exposes initialize/initialized, tools/list and tools/call against the documented MCP 2025-11-25 target contract, advertises only tools capability, and enforces negotiated initialization state and supported-version behavior.

JSON-RPC uses newline-delimited UTF-8 JSON with protocol-only stdout and bounded diagnostics on stderr. The private socket keeps its distinct existing framed protocol; malformed JSON, duplicate keys, invalid method/parameters, duplicate active IDs, unsupported protocol state and excessive size/depth receive bounded protocol failure without forwarding.

Input/output frame size, nesting, active requests and workers have explicit documented bounds compatible with current contribution/frame limits plus envelope overhead. Responses are rejected before unbounded buffering, stdout writes are serialized, and a blocked output or EOF/cancel cannot leak workers; each worker has an owned cancellation/join path.

Calls preserve exact application contribution payload and journal correlation independently of string/numeric MCP connection-local IDs. Tool/domain rejection projects actionable shared diagnostics; structural failures use JSON-RPC errors. Structured results and compatible JSON text preserve pending receipt dimensions without reporting workflow success.

notifications/cancelled cancels only its matching active request in that connection, propagates through the client socket to the handler, ignores unknown/completed IDs and never cancels initialization or another run. Same-live-attempt reconnect requires a new handshake and fresh broker authorization, without minting capability.

Pipe-driven protocol tests and a real private-socket path cover handshake/list/call, numeric/string IDs, malformed/state/version/size/depth/concurrency cases, stdout purity, blocked-output/EOF joins, cancellation races and shared receipt projection. No provider subprocess, new Go module or host-specific configuration is required.

Add strict boolean settings.mcp_auto_start with default true, explicit false preserved, documented template parity and no hot reload. True enables preparation of automatic-registration data; false omits that data while explicit mcp serve remains available with a live descriptor. The setting neither enables issue creation, mints/transfers a grant, changes mode nor broadens tool/sandbox permissions.

After each actual cold/resume/fallback launch binding, enabled policy supplies an optional immutable provider-neutral launch value on the existing agent request: resolved absolute factory executable, structured fixed mcp serve --descriptor arguments, absolute private descriptor path and matching factory attempt reference. Validate and copy values/slices without aliasing; reject stale/mismatched construction and never copy raw capabilities or credentials into arguments. Use the adopted #264 launch seam; do not add provider-specific flags or an alternate binding.

Disabled policy or no active bound attempt yields no automatic launch value; an idle daemon starts no stdio child and allocates no new authority from the setting alone. Registration construction starts no process and writes no host configuration; it leaves all existing request permissions and permitted unrelated host configuration unchanged. #274 consumes this neutral data to register/start the per-host/per-attempt child automatically and owns actual teardown/merge behavior. Prepared data or a true setting must never be reported as a connected host; unavailable host consumption is reported unavailable.

Offline tests cover absent/true/false/invalid config, template parity, enabled/disabled/no-attempt and fresh cold/resume/fallback registration, mismatched descriptors, copied argument slices, permission snapshots and no construction-side process/config effects. Real local pipe/private-socket tests prove explicit serve still works with auto-start false and valid authority, and refuses stale authority. Document the neutral consumer contract and default; do not substitute these fixtures for #274 authentic host startup/teardown and connection evidence.

stories.title: Authorize one exact creation batch with a 30-minute owner approval

user_story.want: to approve an exact proposed batch publicly without distributing a secret
user_story.benefit: creation stays limited to reviewed content for a short time and cannot multiply through retries
notes: Source: feature-spec Owner creation authorization, Data Model, Expiry and Volume Policy.
Planning assumptions for owner review: one batch/up to five artifacts per attempt; twenty artifacts per repository per rolling 24 hours.

acceptance_criteria.text: settings.allow_mcp_story_creation defaults false in strict settings and the documented template, loads once without hot reload and gates discovery and execution of every creation-class MCP path, including aliases/indirect effects. False hides/refuses creation in every mode; true alone grants nothing. No production creation tool is advertised until a real family handler exists.

The daemon accepts only a whole exact /mcp-create <proposal-hash> linked or /mcp-create <proposal-hash> attach command with trusted numeric owner ID and GitHub comment ID/creation timestamp on the matching source issue/repository. Require a retained immutable exact proposal with matching relationship context. Refuse non-owner/bot/copied/quoted commands, absent or changed proposal, wrong source/mode, supplied author claims and stale approval; commands neither enable config nor change mode.

Persist one immutable owner intent per authenticated comment before consuming it. Repeated ingestion cannot mint another intent, and edits cannot alter recorded approval; a changed batch requires a fresh explicit approval. Consume an intent into at most one eligible next launch; no polling control loop is added to active runs.

Approval expires exactly 30 minutes after the trusted approval comment creation timestamp. Intent must be consumed before that deadline; grant expires at min(original deadline, attempt expiry) and refuses at now >= expiry. Processing delay, edits, launch allocation, retries and reconnects never extend it. A consumed grant cannot transfer to resume/fallback/replacement launches, and fresh approval is required after expiry.

Creation authorization requires a live eligible Research attempt, enabled gate and matching factory-held grant for the canonical versioned exact content, repository, source task, artifact count and relationship targets. Recompute the digest of the canonical envelope; caller-supplied hash/IDs alone authorize nothing. No elevated bearer token is exposed in descriptors, prompts, MCP arguments/results or public notices, and credentials remain in their existing factory-held flow.

In one short store transaction, recheck authority/grant/content/quota and reserve at most one batch/grant and five new artifact units per attempt, with twenty units per repository per rolling 24 hours. Count each issue/sub-issue. Confirmed units count within the window; pending/uncertain reservations remain charged regardless of age. Exact duplicates add zero units. Refuse overflow immediately, without queued retry; repositories have isolated budgets.

One grant binds to one durable creation operation and dispatch owner. Concurrent duplicates/retries return that same operation; changed content, foreign attempts, missing/expired/reused grants or a second batch refuse. Reservation happens before external I/O, no transaction spans it, and duplicate transport must not obtain a second dispatch permit. A recorded definitively never-dispatched failure may release quota without reopening the grant; delayed dispatch revalidates its reservation.

Config/parser and real migrated SQLite tests cover gate-off/gate-only, all owner-provenance refusals, comment edit/replay, exact TTL boundary/attempt clamp, absent/foreign/mismatched/expired/reused grants, valid concurrent retries, five/twenty limits, rolling boundaries, unresolved old reservations, cross-repository isolation and absence of elevated-secret serialization. Use a deterministic internal creation handler; no actual issue publication is added.

stories.title: Preserve truthful outcomes through cancellation and restart

user_story.want: interrupted calls to retain their recorded outcomes and original operation identity
user_story.benefit: recovery neither duplicates creation nor presents an uncertain result as success
notes: Source: feature-spec Recovery and boundary proof, Edge Cases, Compatibility and Evidence Obligations.

acceptance_criteria.text: Host EOF/disconnect and MCP cancellation propagate through the adapter/client/broker and join bounded workers. Cancellation before admission leaves no accepted mutation; cancellation after local admission preserves its request/operation identity and truthful pending/confirmed/failed/uncertain outcome, without claiming rollback or success from channel closure.

Same-live-attempt reconnect authenticates again and resolves the same durable application request or operation after a lost reply. Expired/replaced/cancelled/closed attempts and expired creation grants refuse new calls and exact creation replays; separately live and scoped receipt authority may inspect already-admitted history without creating again.

Broker/daemon restart leaves old capability and grant authority dead while retaining operation ownership and quota. Factory-internal reconciliation can observe recorded work; it cannot elect a second dispatcher or automatically repeat uncertain/partial creation. Deferred MCP-origin effect restrictions survive restart.

Fault tests at before reservation, after reservation, before dispatch, after simulated remote create before acknowledgment and partial-batch interruption cover cancel, close, replacement and restart. A deterministic fake creation handler plus real temporary pipes/socket/SQLite proves one durable operation, one reservation and one dispatch owner under concurrent/retry/lost-response calls; it does not claim remote GitHub exactly-once delivery.

Compatibility tests exercise original JSON/helper paths and the adopted shared service alongside MCP, preserving domain validation, independent receipt states and legitimate internal historical recovery. Retained assessment-only Validate communication remains usable with server-side denials and no shell authority.

Document the neutral adapter contract, mode/effect policies, public owner approval flow without secrets, fixed 30-minute expiry, quota constants, revocation/recovery states and #273/#274 consumer boundaries. Execute appropriate focused race tests and repository make check; retain actual outcomes for later read-only Validate. No live provider probes, new modules, integration tags, daemon restart or dist writes are used.

Operator/consumer documentation states that litefactory MCP is additive to existing permitted agent tools, settings.mcp_auto_start defaults true and can disable automatic registration, explicit startup always requires live authority, and no idle daemon-wide stdio child exists. Distinguish #272 prepared registration from #274 actual automatic startup/teardown and connection verification; record unsupported host consumption as unavailable. Preserve all existing 30-minute grant, quota and mode restrictions.
